name.tagline: Computer Science student at VIT Bhopal. I build backend systems and think about system design — mostly Node and Go, with a bias toward background services, queues, and things that stay up.

about: I started with C/C++ and Codeforces, and still do a bit of DSA in C++. These days most of my time goes into backend work: designing services, modelling data, and making the parts talk to each other without falling over.
Recently that's meant Go for background services and Node/TypeScript for APIs — with Postgres, Redis, and Kafka doing the heavy lifting underneath.

projects.name: PulseOps
projects.blurb: Self-hostable uptime and latency monitoring. HTTP and heartbeat checks, incidents, SLA analytics, a web dashboard, a read-only API, and a terminal TUI — the whole stack comes up with one docker compose.

projects.name: AuraMail
projects.blurb: AI placement-email analyzer. Syncs Gmail over OAuth, summarizes with GPT-4 Mini, extracts company, role, deadline and salary, and pushes deadlines to Google Calendar — streamed live over SSE.
projects.role: Go backend, Gmail sync, AI pipeline

projects.name: GitHub Banners
projects.blurb: A Go service that renders live SVG banners of GitHub stats. Multi-token rotation for rate limits, layered in-memory and Postgres caching with soft/hard TTLs, Kafka between services, and HMAC-signed internal calls.

projects.name: TaskFlow
projects.blurb: An authentication microservice — JWT sessions with TOTP two-factor, built to be dropped in front of something else.

projects.name: Arch rice — dotfiles
projects.blurb: My Arch Linux setup: Hyprland on Wayland with a Quickshell bar (Noctalia), plus rofi, mako, fish, Neovim and yazi. Deployed with GNU Stow. Featured on It's FOSS as one of the top Hyprland configs for UI/UX.

projects.name: BrainBox
projects.blurb: Collaborative AI note-taking app with live multiplayer editing.

projects.name: TuneSynz
projects.blurb: Social music discovery built on the Spotify API.

projects.name: CodeQuest Lite
projects.blurb: A tracker for coding challenges and practice streaks.
